{{Quote|UNLOS TAGGE, TEPASI - Baroness Sanya Tagge, leader of the House of Tagge family of nobles, reaffirmed her family's loyalty to the Republic in an address to the people of Tepasi, the Tagge throneworld.|A HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN" />}}
'''Tepasi''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Tepasi system/Legends|Tepasi system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. A forested world situated on the [[Commenor Run/Legends|Commenor Run]], it was colonized by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] before [[26,000 BBY/Legends|26,000 BBY]] and was already emerging as a hub of commerce when it became a [[Core Founder/Legends|founding member]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], [[Tarzen Tagge]] provided aid to the planet after it experienced a series of [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]], precipitating the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord's]] founding of the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]. Tepasi remained loyal to the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] it was the site of the crumbling Tagge Company's only remaining facility.

==Description==
Tepasi was located within a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] [[Tepasi system/Legends|of the same name]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Commenor Run/Legends|Commenor Run]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] which connected it to [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] and [[Korfo system/Legends|Korfo]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was susceptible to [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]],<ref name="GoT">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref> and forests, which supported stealthy predatory [[achtnak]]s, were present on its surface.<ref name="GATORW" /> [[Unlos Tagge]] was a city on Tepasi.<ref name="HNN" />

==History==
Tepasi was colonized by [[Human/Legends|Humans]], who arrived in [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]] from [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], between [[27,500 BBY|27,500]] and [[26,000 BBY/Legends|26,000 BBY]], and around [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], when it was emerging as a hub of commerce, it became a [[Core Founder/Legends|founding member]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" />

In the fourth year of the [[Galactic War]], a corrupt [[Gender/Legends|female]] customs official who quit from an arms smuggling for a local syndicate was looking for a new place to call home.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Change of Address}}</ref>

Around [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="FF">{{FactFile2014|6|CHR 1-4|Christophsis}}</ref> a wealthy<ref name="FF" /> family of Tepasi nobles made investments that made the conversion of the [[Christoph system/Legends|Christoph system]] into a viable mining concern possible.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tarzen Tagge]] used his fleet of small [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] to deliver supplies and crews to an area of Tepasi that had been devastated by a series of [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]], thereby becoming a local hero. By the time the area's production facilities and roads were rebuilt, Tagge had founded the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]], a construction firm which operated as a front for his [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operations.<ref name="GoT" />

Tepasi eventually became the throneworld of the [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]] family of nobles, and in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] [[Sanya Tagge/Legends|Sanya Tagge]] reaffirmed the family's loyalty to the Republic in an address to the populace of Tepasi.<ref name="HNN" /> It indeed remained within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] loyal to the Galactic Republic upon the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />  After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the Tagge Company crumbled and its holdings were ultimately reduced to a single facility on Tepasi, where the Tagge family was still well-respected.<ref name="GoT" /> Tepasi was a stronghold of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Hunt for Zsinj]] of [[7 ABY/Legends|7]]&ndash;[[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] and the [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. By [[137 ABY]], Tepasi was within territory claimed by [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] and was part of the region known as the [[Core Worlds Security Zone]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Tepasi was inhabited by Humans from Kuat beginning in the period from 27,500 to 26,000 BBY and featured at least one noble family by approximately 600 BBY.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Faro Argyus/Legends|Faro Argyus]], a [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]] for the Republic, came from Tepasi.
